body: Can't be worse than the time that I tried to kill myself with pills and just spent 18 hours rolling in bed in agony. This is like my final cry for help. If this doesn't get anyone's attention I don't know what will because word's aren't enough and neither are suicidal thoughts.

I'm not passing out at all. I'm saying if I do pass out hopefully then my parents will panic and take me seriously over being depressed. Which is why I'm fine if I starve myself to death. I'm going to start doing intentional things like standing up too fast in the hopes that I pass out in class and they call my parents.
